incidents-bot: PAGER: SRE P1 - Routing visibility + region-flap (INC-2026-1912)
incidents-bot: Symptoms: subset of requests routed to fallback variant then bouncing between asia-southeast-1 <-> us-west-2. Elevated latencies and model-quality regressions reported. Paging SRE.

theo (oncall): Acknowledged, I'm oncall for SRE today. Taking lead.

eric (support): Two paying customers reporting noisy outputs and timeouts: neo-payments & blueanalytics. They provided request ids and timestamps.

priya (sre): Dropping one request id from neo-payments: request_id=9ab4d2ff-c33, observed ~ 02:14 UTC. Can someone pull decision logs?

maya (eng-runtime): pulling trace for 9ab4d2ff-c33 now. Quick heads-up: we deployed policy change "cost_saver_v2" at 02:05 that added cross-region fallback heuristics.

maya (eng-runtime): Decision excerpt for 9ab4d2ff-c33 (sanitized):
```
{ "request_id": "9ab4d2ff-c33", "decision": { "route": "asia-southeast-1", "variant": "redwood-rlhf-8x", "policy": "cost_saver_v2", "decision_meta": { "score": 0.42 } }, "latency_ms": 1450 }
```
Note: decision_meta lacks "route_tag" and there is no fallback_history array.

priya (sre): That variant is not the pinned model for neo-payments; they should be routed to redwood-legacy-16 pinned via tenant-policy. Policy ordering should have prevented cost_saver_v2 from matching pinned tenants.

zane (platform): I see a platform-level change in the serializer that trimmed optional keys to reduce log size around 01:58. That might explain missing route_tag.

priya (sre): Any evidence of region flapping?

maya (eng-runtime): Yes — for the same request trace series we see fast retries that choose asia-southeast-1 then fallback to us-west-2 then back. Replays show the routing decision toggling because the failover window incorrectly treats transient latency as capacity shortfall. The fallback policy uses a ttl of 10s, which is too aggressive.

incidents-bot: DETECTED: spike in route_switch events for cost_saver_v2 between 02:10-02:18 UTC.

eric (support): Customer impact: neo-payments reported 7 slow requests and one malformed invoice text. blueanalytics reported timeouts in batch scoring. No PII leaked.

priya (sre): Immediate mitigations: 1) disable cost_saver_v2, 2) increase failover ttl to 60s, 3) restore route_tag and fallback_history fields in decision logs. Can we do those quickly?

maya (eng-runtime): Disabling cost_saver_v2 via control-plane now.

(maya runs)
```
curl -X POST "https://control.internal/api/policies/cost_saver_v2/disable" -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]"
```

incidents-bot: Policy cost_saver_v2 disabled by maya at 02:27 UTC.

zane (platform): Rolling back the serializer change to restore route_tag & fallback_history to rich logs. Pushing to canary.

priya (sre): After disabling policy, can someone replay a sample traffic to confirm routing stability?

maya (eng-runtime): Replayed sample; routing now honours tenant pin and route_tag restored on replay traces. p95 latency for neo-payments back to 180ms in replay.

priya (sre): Good. But we still need to address why the pinned-tenant predicate evaluated false earlier. Any predicate telemetry?

maya (eng-runtime): Looks like the predicate evaluation relies on tenant metadata passed by auth-proxy; we saw a race where the proxy returned stale cache entries for tenant tags for ~2 minutes after a deploy at 01:52. That combined with policy ordering allowed cost_saver_v2 to match.

priya (sre): So multi-factor root cause: 1) policy ordering allowed cost_saver_v2 to outrank tenant-pin, 2) auth-proxy stale tag cache, 3) serializer trimmed observability fields.

priya (sre): Action items (short term):
- maya: keep cost_saver_v2 disabled while we fix ordering and ttl (ETA 3h)
- zane: revert serializer change and ensure route_tag is mandatory in decision logs (ETA 1h)
- priya: add alert when missing route_tag >0.05% of decisions per minute (ETA 2h)
- platform: add canary gate for auth-proxy cache invalidation on deploys (zane)
- support (eric): send incident notification and apology to affected tenants with impact summary

eric (support): Drafting customer note. Need numbers for impacted requests.

priya (sre): From sampling: ~860 requests misrouted between 02:10-02:22 UTC across both tenants. Error rate for those tenants rose from 0.1% -> 4.5%, and model quality regression detected in ~2% of responses (hallucination-like).

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1912 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded from P1 to P2.

theo (oncall): I'll hand off monitoring to night oncall @lina at 18:00 UTC. Lina, please watch for any re-enablement of cost_saver_v2 or any recurrence of region flapping; escalate if route_tag drops again.

lina (oncall): Ack handoff. I'll keep an eye on route_tag alert and any retry storms.

priya (sre): Postmortem sketch: root cause = policy ordering + auth-proxy cache race + logging regression. Observability gap = missing route_tag & fallback_history delayed attribution. Impact = ~860 requests, 2 customers, elevated latency and some degraded outputs. Remediations: make route_tag required in decision logs, add alerting on missing route tags, add pre-deploy canary for auth-proxy cache invalidation, PR to re-evaluate policy precedence and adjust failover ttl.

theo (oncall): Closing Slack thread; opening PM ticket for full postmortem and assigning owners. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
